acceptanceCriteria: TestCALV0131 passes with the macOS default TMPDIR under /var/folders and with a symlink-free TMPDIR.
The fix reuses the V1-0753/V1-0840 temp-root resolution helper rather than a new copy.
body: Found by the V1-0955 lane on 2026-10-07 at base 8af2bf62 (also fails at base). On macOS the default TMPDIR /var/folders/... crosses the /var symlink; snapshot.Probe -> intent.CheckNoSymlink refuses with UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM, so TestCALV0131 fails; it passes with a symlink-free TMPDIR such as /private/tmp/claude-501/x. Same class as V1-0753 (PSR store tests) and V1-0840 (service tests), both completed; this test was not covered. Expected: the test resolves its temp root (filepath.EvalSymlinks) like the V1-0753/V1-0840 repairs, or documents the requirement.
title: tests: TestCALV0131 fails UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM when TMPDIR has a symlinked ancestor (macOS /var/folders)
